text: [293] 22 chayime bhikkhave aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi taṃ suṇātha .pe. katame ca bhikkhave cha aparihāniyā dhammā na kammārāmatā na bhassārāmatā na niddārāmatā na saṅgaṇikārāmatā sovacassatā kalyāṇamittatā ime kho bhikkhave cha aparihāniyā dhammā ye hi keci bhikkhave atītamaddhānaṃ na parihāyiṃsu kusalehi dhammehi sabbe te imeheva chahi dhammehi na parihāyiṃsu kusalehi dhammehi ye 1 hi keci bhikkhave anāgatamaddhānaṃ na parihāyissanti kusalehi dhammehi sabbe te imeheva chahi dhammehi na parihāyissanti kusalehi dhammehi ye 1 hi keci bhikkhave etarahi na parihāyanti kusalehi dhammehi sabba te imeheva chahi dhammehi na parihāyanti kusalehi dhammehīti .
